source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 17. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Lady Haleemah, the return to Makkah, and becoming an orphan

learn.en: Quraysh families sent their babies to the desert for good health and pure Arabic.
learn.title: Raised in the desert

learn.en: Lady Haleemah Sa'diyyah cared for him for four years. As soon as he could walk, he helped look after the sheep.
learn.title: With Lady Haleemah

learn.en: After four years his mother Aminah brought him home to Makkah.
learn.title: Back to Makkah

learn.en: When he was six, his mother fell ill and died at Abwa, on the way back from Madinah.
learn.title: Losing his mother

learn.en: He had lost both parents — he was a yateem (an orphan). But Allah cared for him at every step.
learn.title: An orphan

learn.en: “Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?” (Qur'an 93:6)
learn.title: Allah's care

opts: The lady who raised him in the desert

quiz.en: How many years did he stay with Haleemah?
How old was he when his mother died?
True or false? A yateem is a child who has lost his parents.

think.q: Even after losing both parents, Allah cared for the Prophet ﷺ. How can we be kind to orphans?
think.a: We can share with them, play with them, and help them — the Prophet ﷺ loved kindness to orphans.

parents.summary: Raised in the desert by Lady Haleemah for four years, back to Makkah, and an orphan by age six — with Allah's care.
parents.tip: Talk about a way your family could help orphans.
